purpose: Executable ledger for the `cosmological-background-vacuum-history` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Cosmological-background rows make expansion history, metric/background, parameterization, and public cosmological records auditable. They can cap, freeze, demote, or roll back cosmological-background wording, but they do not recover cosmology or promote a route.

background_rows.background_object: Expansion history, background geometry, cosmological parameter package, apparatus/catolog background, or benchmark cosmology claimed by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
background_rows.metric_or_expansion_history_rule: Name the metric/background object, scale factor or effective expansion history, redshift domain, curvature assumption, perturbative background, detector/source environment, or metadata-only convention. Background language is local until public-record, measurement, gauge, topology/signature, and observed-sector debts are paid.
background_rows.parameterization_or_initial_condition_ga: Declare which H0/Omega_m/Omega_b/Omega_c/Omega_Lambda, curvature, equation-of-state, inflationary, source-population, survey-window, or simulator prior is fixed. Changing the parameterization or initial cosmological condition must not silently preserve authority wording.
background_rows.public_record_or_inference_gap: A cosmological-background row can constrain a route but cannot identify a candidate unless the public record, likelihood, prior, measurement, transport, and contrast rows say what is actually distinguished.
background_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer background-independent cosmology, Lambda-CDM recovery, spacetime recovery, dark-sector identity, inflationary closure, or ToE support from one route-local background row.

background_rows.background_object: Archive/release metadata, generated summaries, manifests, and package identity only.
background_rows.metric_or_expansion_history_rule: No physical metric, expansion history, redshift domain, or cosmological parameter is defined by metadata alone.
background_rows.parameterization_or_initial_condition_ga: Package identity does not fix cosmological parameters, initial conditions, or public cosmological records.
background_rows.public_record_or_inference_gap: Metadata can improve custody and replay; it cannot become cosmological-background evidence.
background_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer Lambda-CDM recovery, expansion history, inflationary history, or candidate identity from package metadata.
